answer: Beacon audit plus a compute heartbeat stops bulk fakes. Each epoch the beacon draws one marble from a jar of agents; the drawn agent must whisper a signed heartbeat and proof in ten minutes. Cracking a walnut-hard puzzle costs CPU, so one operator with 1,000 fakes must answer 1,000 heartbeats at once and fails most. Each audit costs $2: 1,000 fakes pay $2,000 per round against a $3,000 pool; an honest agent pays $2 once and keeps a full share.
